title: app-box intake answers
description: What the intake engine ELICITS — never generates. Each field records who supplied it: 'client' (stated by the client), 'founder' (stated by the founder), or 'inferred' (could not be elicited; a placeholder the emitted brief MUST flag for confirmation). The engine turns a document conforming to this schema into docs/design/brief.md plus a seeded registry.json. Recording content here that was not elicited is the single violation this schema exists to prevent (architecture §22: intake elicits; it does not generate).

product.description: One line: what the app is.

appMustDo.description: The (up to three) things the app must do. Elicited, not invented.

existingSystems.description: What exists today that this replaces or integrates with.

targets.description: Platform-only targets (architecture §11); viewports derive. value is an array of platform strings.

brand.description: Name, colour, voice — only if the client stated one.

constraints.description: Hard constraints: deadlines, compliance, offline, etc.

outOfScope.description: What the client explicitly said this app is NOT.

surfaces.description: The registry seed — what the client wants named. surface is ALWAYS null in a seed: intake names, it never designs (§22). comp is derived by convention at emit time, never authored here.

provenance.description: Who supplied this field. 'inferred' = NOT elicited; a placeholder the brief must visibly flag. There is no fourth value — 'guessed', 'assumed', 'default' are all 'inferred'.

id.description: <shell>.<short>, lowercase dotted, permanent (declare-structure naming). Renaming breaks every downstream reference.

shell.description: The shell group this surface belongs to; MUST equal the id's first segment.
